response.description:
Azure Application Gateway now supports keyless TLS
termination using certificates whose private keys stay in Azure Key Vault
Managed HSM. Each TLS handshake signature is performed inside the HSM, and the
private key is never exported to the gateway. This integration helps you: 
 Maintain
     private key custody within a dedicated HSM boundary. 
 Use
     managed identities and role-based access control for key access. 
 Monitor
     signing operations through Managed HSM diagnostic logs. 
 Obtain
     cryptographic evidence that the TLS key was generated and is stored in a
     FIPS 140-3 Level 3 validated HSM. 
 Support
     separation of duties and centralized key management. Learn more: What is keyless TLS for Azure
Application Gateway and Azure Key Vault Managed HSM? Tutorial: Configure keyless
TLS termination with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM What is
Azure Key Vault Managed HSM?
response.title: Generally Available: Keyless TLS on Application Gateway with Azure Key Vault Managed HSM
